answer: The shale holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
